name: power-app-dataverse-codex-plugin
description: Enterprise guidance skills for designing conversational Dataverse and Power Apps action workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Design governed AI action workflows for Dataverse and Power Apps.
interface.longDescription: A Codex plugin for shaping Dataverse and Power Apps into a conversational enterprise execution platform. It helps translate business intent into action designs, workflow orchestration, ALM readiness checks, data operations plans, and safety governance reviews. Version 1 provides planning, review, and implementation guidance only; it does not authenticate to or execute against live Dataverse environments.
defaultPrompt: Design a Dataverse AI action workflow.
Review this Power Apps solution for ALM readiness.
Assess governance risks for this Dataverse action.
